name: Stop Sign
description: Indicates that the driver must bring the vehicle to a complete stop behind the stop line and only proceed when it is safe to do so.

name: Yield
description: Indicates that the driver must give right-of-way to traffic approaching the intersection from other directions.

name: No Parking
description: Prohibits the parking of vehicles. A vehicle may stop briefly to drop off or pick up passengers, but must not remain stationary.

name: No Stopping
description: Prohibits all stopping of vehicles at any time in the indicated zone. More restrictive than the No Parking sign.

name: No U-Turn
description: Prohibits drivers from making a U-turn at the intersection or road section where this sign is displayed.

name: No Left Turn
description: Prohibits vehicles from turning left at the intersection where this sign is placed.

name: No Right Turn
description: Prohibits vehicles from turning right at the intersection where this sign is placed.

name: No Entry
description: Indicates that no vehicles are allowed to enter the roadway beyond this sign.

name: Speed Limit 60 km/h
description: Indicates the maximum permissible speed permitted on this road section is 60 kilometres per hour.

name: Speed Limit 80 km/h
description: Indicates the maximum permissible speed permitted on this road section is 80 kilometres per hour.

name: Speed Limit 100 km/h
description: Indicates the maximum permissible speed permitted on this road section is 100 kilometres per hour.

name: Speed Limit 120 km/h
description: Indicates the maximum permissible speed permitted on this road section is 120 kilometres per hour, typically on freeways.

name: Proceed Straight Only
description: Mandatory sign indicating that drivers are only permitted to travel straight ahead.

name: Turn Left
description: Mandatory sign indicating that drivers must turn left at the intersection where this sign is displayed.

name: Turn Right
description: Mandatory sign indicating that drivers must turn right at the intersection where this sign is displayed.

name: Sharp Curve to the Right
description: Warns drivers of a sharp bend in the road ahead towards the right direction.

name: Sharp Curve to the Left
description: Warns drivers of a sharp bend in the road ahead towards the left direction.

name: Steep Descent
description: Warns drivers of a steep downhill gradient ahead. Reduce speed and select a lower gear before descending.

name: Crossroad Ahead
description: Warns drivers that a major, uncontrolled intersecting road is immediately ahead.

name: T-Junction — Side Road Right
description: Warns drivers that a road joins from the right ahead. Traffic on the joining road must yield.

name: Traffic Signal Ahead
description: Warns drivers to prepare for a robot (traffic light) intersection ahead.

name: Pedestrian Crossing
description: Warns that a designated pedestrian crossing is coming up; be ready to stop.

name: School Children
description: Warns drivers that a school is nearby and children may be crossing the road. Reduce speed and proceed with caution.

name: Road Narrows
description: Warns drivers that the road narrows ahead on both sides. Be prepared to slow down and allow oncoming vehicles to pass.

name: Slippery Road
description: Warns of a slippery road surface ahead. Reduce speed, avoid harsh braking or steering, and increase following distance.

name: Road Works
description: Warns drivers of road construction or maintenance activity ahead. Reduce speed, be alert for workers, and follow temporary signs.

name: National Route Marker
description: Identifies a national route (N-road) in South Africa. These are the major inter-city and inter-provincial routes.

name: Information Sign — Hospital
description: Informs drivers of the proximity of a hospital facility where medical services are available.

name: Parking Area
description: Indicates the location of a designated parking area where vehicles may be left for an extended period.
